contracts: PRG004: retain the actual final 2560 success dispatch after its final cancellation check; allow the sole render worker to finish; perform and save another UI gesture; wait for the independent exact CPU reference of the new preview; release the original queued success lambda and observe its existing revision guard reject it once.

PRG009: retain actual old final success; switch through the real filmstrip; hold successful real SessionService load before its original queued completion; deliver old render while busy=true and new load deliveries=0; verify revision rejection and no image/histogram/document/UI-state mutation; release real load and verify the new photo and return to saved old edits.

ZOM005: enter actual 100% view, verify Retina-aware scene pixels, pan via pointer input, switch to another photo and back through the filmstrip; each load resets zoom and both pan offsets to Fit, preserves saved edits and starts fresh history.

Independent CPU pixels distinguish the obsolete and newer results; exact job/controller/revision/asset identity is checked between retained result and original GUI delivery. Old handles are cancelled. No callbacks or pixel results are fabricated.
Late success leaves current URL/pixels/histogram, full document, history, selection, catalog revision and originals unchanged. Two-gesture Undo/Redo remains correct after same-photo reordering.
Own generated source SHA256 values are recorded before import and checked after each final scenario; shared fixture integrity is independently checked by the runner.
9/9 final local offscreen new-case repetitions, 3/3 existing zoom/export regressions and 3/3 authorized Cocoa/Metal Retina DPR2 cases pass without QML warnings, catalog or source integrity failures.

All targets build; shipping QML smoke and defined-symbol isolation pass. The new probe is present in UX and absent from the shipping executable. 40 runner and 10 policy checks pass, formatting and affected blocking tidy checks pass.

CI and release workflows require PRG004/009 and ZOM002/005 with three repetitions and build provenance; their reports and zoom scene patches are retained. Workflow YAML parsed with the existing model venv PyYAML.
limits: Final source/binary identity is recorded by each report. Workflow-only additions separate the nine-case offscreen source hash from the later native/previous-scenario hash; the UX executable SHA is unchanged.

The exploratory initial PRG009 delivered the obsolete render after the new image; the final version instead proves immediate invalidation while the next load is held. Initial secondary-chart hashing was after import; final primary and secondary hashes are captured before import.
The renderer preference is switched to CPU through Settings to isolate ordering and geometry. Native Metal denotes the Qt scene backend, not use of the DevelopAccelerator.
Local GITHUB_ACTIONS=true selects offscreen/software DPR1. The raw hosted_ci flag does not identify a remote CI run.

Independent CPU oracle work runs on the GUI thread; heartbeat stalls are not product performance measurements. No load/stress, RAW, actual GPU-command completion reordering, physical input, pan-boundary exhaustion, external display or OS memory-pressure claim.
Blocking tidy checks pass; existing optional-access diagnostics remain behind throwing require() preconditions. No analyzer error was reported.
Native permission was a single two-minute quiet interval, completed after the three cases; no ongoing permission is inferred.
Overall release qualification, BUG045 and other legacy/later-phase/hardware/installer/updater gaps remain open. No 1.0 publication.
